title: RBI Eases FPI G-Sec Investment Norms & Merges General/Long-Term Limits
summary: Removes short-term, security-wise, and concentration limits for FPIs under General Route.

blocks.content: Removes short-term, security-wise, and concentration limits for FPIs under General Route.

items: Limit Removal: Withdrew short-term, security-wise, and concentration limits for FPI G-Sec investments.
Limit Merging: Merged general and long-term sub-limits into a single limit for Central & State Government Securities (SGSs).
FAR Designation: Designated 15-yr, 30-yr, and 40-yr G-Secs under Fully Accessible Route (FAR).

blocks.title: Static Background & GK Context
blocks.summary: Fully Accessible Route (FAR) allows un-capped FPI investment in specified G-Secs.

blocks.title: Exam Trap & Statutory Distinction
blocks.content: ⚠️ **Regulatory Compliance Trap:** Ensure exact compliance dates, institutional ceilings, and penalty provisions are verified during recall.
